PO.Data: A Business Partner is anyone with whom you transact. This can include Vendor, Customer, Employee or Salesperson

The Order is a control document. The Order is complete when the quantity ordered is the same as the quantity shipped and invoiced. When you close an order, unshipped (backordered) quantities are cancelled.
The Payment is a unique identifier of this payment.
Sum of planned hours per week for this service plan
The Total Weekly Hours is the sum of all planned hours per week across all visit schedules for this service plan. It is automatically calculated from the service schedule entries.
